items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: He would write and send me material.

ctx.x: Yeah, lives in a little alley, you know, and he writes. He would write and send me material. He -- it's the most illegible writing you've ever seen in your life but the one thing that would bug me, he's a Jehovah's Witness and half -- two thirds of the lesson would be chapters of the bible. You know, he was trying to -- all Jehovah's Witnesses try to convert you, you know, this is their function in life. And it got to the point that I had to talk religion all the time with him, so -- you know. But a marvelous mind.
So now Pat Martine is one of his disciples, you know,

and of course another young guitarist is Joe Pass. Of course Joe's not that young, but I -- how old -- I think Joe is around --he's got to be in his late forties. Kenny Burrell. About 41. But you have some other young guitarists. I have some students who are marvelous guitarists. Very good technique, you have Lee Ritenour. Baby. And he's a monster. He's about 21?
